query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'dyads',(select count(*) from scoring.foundation_dyad),
 'revisions',(select count(*) from scoring.foundation_revision),
 'invalid_memberships',(select count(*) from scoring.foundation_dyad d where not exists(select 1 from public.memberships m where m.organization_id=d.organization_id and m.user_id=d.collaborator_user_id)),
 'invalid_contact_org',(select count(*) from scoring.foundation_dyad d join public.contacts c on c.id=d.contact_id where c.organization_id<>d.organization_id),
 'snapshots',(select count(*) from scoring.foundation_snapshot),
 'snapshot_payload_keys',(select jsonb_agg(k) from (select distinct jsonb_object_keys(payload) k from scoring.foundation_snapshot) s),
 'event_quality',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select payload->>'identityQuality' identity_quality,payload->>'completeness' completeness,count(*) n from scoring.foundation_revision where kind='event' group by 1,2) t),
 'classifier_errors',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select result_status,payload->>'error' error,count(*) n from scoring.foundation_classifier_run group by 1,2) t)
) integrity

final_snapshot_check.query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'snapshot_groups',(select jsonb_agg(t) from (select payload->>'authority' authority,payload->>'status' status,payload->'score' score,payload->'reliability' reliability,count(*) n from scoring.foundation_snapshot group by 1,2,3,4) t),
 'accepted_foundation_markers',(select count(*) from scoring.foundation_revision where kind='marker' and payload->>'status'='accepted'),
 'versioned_migrations',(select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'active_jobs',(select count(*) from cron.job where active),
 'sources',(select jsonb_build_object('messages',(select count(*) from public.communication_messages),'meetings',(select count(*) from public.meetings),'contacts',(select count(*) from public.contacts)))) as integrity
